title: Rev. Ekole Alexander sent off from Presbyterian Church Guneku
excerpt: A send-off service was held on Sunday 23 June 2024 for Rev. Ekole Alexander, leaving his post as Parish Pastor of Presbyterian Church Guneku to take up appointment as Presbytery Treasurer in Bali.
sourceNote: Community record — Mbengwi Online (Facebook group and blog), reported by Fongoh P. Ayeh. Written fresh from the reported facts and attributed; no text or photograph of theirs is reproduced. Recorded 2026-09-02.
body:
A send-off service was held on Sunday 23 June 2024 for Rev. Ekole Alexander, who was leaving his post as Parish Pastor of Presbyterian Church (PC) Guneku to take up appointment as Presbytery Treasurer in Bali.

PC Guneku stands within the Palace grounds. The village record notes that there are as many churches in Guneku as there are quarters, and that the Palace itself is surrounded by them.

Who succeeded Rev. Ekole at PC Guneku is not established in the sources and is not stated here.
